LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Settings.AutoFitPortrait: Renders each pawn once to measure the area it actually covers, then sizes the portrait to it. Animals, mechanoids, insects, and entities are shown at about a human's size and centered on what is drawn. Humanlike pawns, including modded races, are never zoomed in; they only zoom out when something like a large hat or wings makes them much bigger than usual, so ordinary colonists keep their framing.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Settings.ShowHoverToolba: Hovering the panel shows Edit, Reset, and Settings buttons along its bottom.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Settings.ResetPawnAdjust: Settings were reset. Also delete the {0} per-pawn adjustments stored in this save?
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Toolbar.EditTooltip: Edit this portrait: drag to move, mouse wheel to zoom (Shift for fine steps), right-click for more.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Toolbar.ResetTooltip: Delete the {0} category adjustment. Race, variant, and pawn adjustments stay; delete those from the right-click menu in edit mode.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Toolbar.PinTooltip: Keep showing this pawn even when another one is selected.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Edit.Hint: Drag: move · Wheel: zoom (Shift: fine) · Edge tabs: crop · Corner: resize · Ctrl+Z: undo · Right-click: menu · Esc: finish

LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Saved.Hint: Adjustments made in edit mode. Per-pawn ones are stored in the current save; category, race, and variant ones apply to every save.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Saved.NoGame: Load a game to see per-pawn adjustments.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Saved.DeleteAllPawnsConf: Delete all {0} per-pawn adjustments in this save?
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Hint.FirstRun: Hover over the portrait panel to show its edit tools.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Edit.PresetTooltip: Frame the pawn this way and save it to the selected scope.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Edit.CropTooltip: Drag to hide the top or bottom of the panel.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Adjust.Title: Adjustment: {0}
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Edit.ScopeTooltip: Choose where edits are stored, from the pawn's category down to this pawn. Narrower levels apply on top of broader ones. A dot marks levels that already hold an adjustment.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Menu.ClearAllScopes: Delete all of this pawn's adjustments
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.ScopeHelp.Category: Applies to every pawn in the same category, such as all humanlikes or all animals. Use it to set a whole group's size and framing in one go; it is usually the best place to start.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.ScopeHelp.Race: Applies to every pawn of this race, such as all thrumbos or all humans. Use it for races whose art is unusually large or small, and for modded races.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.ScopeHelp.Variant: Applies only to this xenotype (humanlike) or growth stage (animals) within the race. Use it when babies and adults, or xenotypes with different builds, need their own framing.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.ScopeHelp.Pawn: Applies only to this pawn and is stored in the save. Use it when one particular colonist should look different.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.ScopeHelp.VariantUnavail: This pawn has no variant level. Humanlike pawns are split by xenotype only with Biotech, and races with a single growth stage, such as most mechanoids, have none.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Toolbar.ResetConfirm: Delete the {0} category adjustment? It applies to every pawn in that category.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Toolbar.UnpinTooltip: Unpin: follow the selected pawn again.
LanguageData.PortraitOverlay.Settings.ShowPinButtonTo: Hovering the panel shows a pin button in its top-right corner. Pinning keeps this pawn on screen when another is selected; the pin stays visible while pinned. Turning this off also unpins.
